31. (Currently Amended) A system for treating obesity, the system comprising: a gastric space filler comprising a first balloon connected to a second balloon by a conduit, wherein the gastric space filler is configured to occupy a substantial volume of a gastric cavity in the human patient in an inflated state; and an instrument throughput channel extending through the conduit, wherein the instrument throughput channel is configured to receive instruments, __wherein the first balloon and the second balloon are positioned in a non-overlapping configuration within the gastric cavity__.

32. (Currently Amended) The system of claim 31 wherein the conduit comprises a first lumen in fluid communication with the first balloon, a second lumen in fluid communication with the second balloon, and a third lumen defining the instrument throughput channel, __wherein the first, second, and third lumens are arranged in a side-by-side configuration__.

33. (Currently Amended) The system of claim 31 wherein the conduit has an axial length, and wherein the instrument throughput channel extends along the axial length, __wherein the instrument throughput channel is positioned centrally within the conduit__.

34. (Cancelled)

35. (Currently Amended) The system of claim 31 wherein the first and second balloons are made from at least one of the following: silicone, latex, polyethylene, polyurethane, and nylon, __and wherein the balloons have a wall thickness of 0.1 to 0.5 mm__.

36. (Currently Amended) The system of claim 31 wherein the conduit comprises an inter-balloon section spacing the first balloon apart from the second balloon, and wherein the inter-balloon section has a length of about 10-40 mm, __wherein the inter-balloon section maintains a substantially rigid configuration__.

41. (Currently Amended) The system of claim 31, further comprising a delivery catheter configured to deliver the gastric space filler to the gastric cavity via an esophagus of the patient, wherein the delivery catheter is configured to receive the gastric space filler in a collapsed state, __wherein the delivery catheter has an outer diameter of 18-24 French__.

42. (Currently Amended) A gastric space filler system, comprising: a conduit having a first end and a second end opposite the first end, wherein the first end is operably coupled to a first balloon and the second end is operably coupled to a second balloon; a first lumen through the conduit, wherein the lumen is configured for fluid infusion into the first balloon; a second lumen through the conduit, wherein the second lumen is configured for fluid infusion into the second balloon; and a third lumen extending through the conduit, wherein the third lumen is configured for instrument throughput, __wherein the first and second balloons are positioned in a non-overlapping configuration__.

43. (Currently Amended) The gastric space filler system of claim 42 wherein: the first lumen extends from the first end of the conduit to the first balloon; and the second lumen extends from the first end of the conduit to the second balloon, __wherein the first and second lumens are arranged in a side-by-side configuration within the conduit__.

44. (Currently Amended) The gastric space filler system of claim 42 wherein the third lumen extends from the first end of the conduit to a second end of the conduit, __wherein the third lumen is positioned centrally within the conduit__.

45. (Currently Amended) The gastric space filler system of claim 42, further comprising a coupling mechanism at the first end of the conduit, wherein the coupling mechanism is configured for instrument throughput into the third lumen and configured to couple to a delivery catheter and/or a filling tube, __wherein the coupling mechanism comprises a luer lock connector__.

46. (Currently Amended) The gastric space filler system of claim 42 wherein the gastric space filler system is configured for delivery through an esophagus of a patient to a stomach of the patient, __wherein the system is configured to be delivered in a collapsed state and expanded within the stomach__.

47. (Currently Amended) The gastric space filler system of claim 42 wherein the conduit is configured for attachment to a delivery catheter, and wherein the third lumen of the conduit is configured to receive an instrument passed through the delivery catheter, __wherein the instrument comprises a guidewire or a therapeutic device__.
